study.question: Does the inherited click residual-scorer input stop help the stronger joint linear-moment/private-readout model, or does it suppress useful learning now that a shared relation/moment path is present?
study.hypothesis: Observation: g3-r0006-linear_private macro AUC 0.8294419075559136 exceeds g0-r0005-linear_moment by 0.001115634060181009, but exceeds the capacity/execution-matched linear_mean by only 0.000361570849778059 at one seed. Versus mean, task AUC deltas [click,cart,fav,buy] are [-0.00032269414748764547,-0.00007882157327643302,+0.00019859976714131644,+0.00164919935273522]; corresponding logloss deltas are [+0.00003485178259260424,+0.000010534451605773154,-0.00003327396411605295,-0.000040476267522153095]. Mechanism hypothesis: the residual click-input stop may now withhold useful target/action/key representation gradients; opening it could improve macro AUC without extra capacity. This is provisional and has a competing hypothesis that click gradients interfere with rare-task learning. The old stop source is architecturally different, so its effectiveness cannot be transferred. The experiment changes a learning rule using existing switches; it is attribution, not a novel architecture.

Inherit the concept of detaching selected relevance inputs. Here four residual scorers augment a shared relation/moment token model; the old private-trunk DIN adaptation is not a matched control.

inherited_components: All source architecture from g3-r0006-linear_private: shared embeddings, unnormalized shared relevance, target relation summaries/counts, five chronological bins and signed first moments, JointBlock and four towers
Four action-aware residual scorers with distinct hidden initialization and zero output layers, forked CPU RNG, private routing and independent Dice buffers
Existing block_click_score_grad and block_aux_score_grad switches from local lineage; no changed labels, inputs, host recipe, scorer sharing or loss weights
study.proposed_difference: Use existing input-detach switches in a complete two-factor experiment on the committed stronger representation. Principal candidate opens all residual-scorer inputs (C=0,A=0); include exact parent replay (1,0), aux-only stop (0,1) and both stop (1,1). No parameter, inference function, state-key or initialization change. There is no new architectural novelty claim. Only residual-score input paths are affected; this cannot isolate all gradients from a task.
predictions: Primary directional prediction: linear_grad_open exceeds the click-stop replay on four-task macro validation AUC; report click and rare-task trade-offs instead of applying a new task veto.

For identical weights and buffers, all four configurations produce identical probabilities and inference cost within measurement noise; total parameters should remain 33059849 (dense1266633, embeddings31793216). Train cost may differ with backward connectivity and must be measured.

The zero-output residual initialization gives identical initial functions and initially zero scorer-input gradients. After output weights become nonzero, opening a branch must restore its scorer-input gradient while stopped branches retain scorer-parameter and value-path gradients.

Under private routing, each residual scorer uses its corresponding task loss; changes in other task performance can arise through shared embeddings. Shared moment/local-activation paths remain active in all cells.
falsifiers: No repeat-confirmed macro-AUC improvement from opening click inputs opposes the proposed beneficial-gradient explanation; a repeated deterioration favors keeping the stop locally.
Equivalent or inconsistent click effects across seeds, or gains reproduced by auxiliary/both stops, oppose a specifically click-related explanation.

Failure of identical-state forward parity, exact replay tolerance, unchanged parameter shapes, causal masking or expected branch-gradient connectivity invalidates interpretation; record host failures and their costs.

A gain over DIN or either weaker source without beating the stronger g0 and relevant capacity control does not establish complementary task conditioning. A win at a changed stop setting alone cannot establish task conditioning beyond capacity.
alternative_explanations: Finite-seed noise, reused-validation selection and purchase AUC instability: only4036 buy positives over2871767 impressions; user-cluster bootstrap is needed where the host supports it.

Additional capacity explains much of the source-to-combination gain: linear_mean already reaches0.8290803367061356. Historical private-minus-mean effects are0.000361570849778059 with linear moments and0.0005744612137852378 with copy moments, interaction -0.0002128903640071788; this does not support positive synergy.
Opening stops changes gradient magnitude and clipping as well as transfer; without gradient diagnostics it does not demonstrate conflicting gradients or gradient isolation.

Exploratory parent-versus-g0 empty-history macro AUC regresses0.003108705683836255 on6444 examples with task positive counts427/45/28/13, while longer-history slices improve. Global shared-parameter changes can affect empty histories despite zero residual pooling. These slices are descriptive, not proof of a sequence mechanism.

All seven supplied trials succeeded with no error; no failed local experiment is supplied. Lower-quality copy and mean branches are retained as counterevidence. Scoped agent-memory searches returned no records; older campaigns and closed test outcomes are unavailable, not negative results.
Offline historical feedback visibility, whole-window vocabularies/static snapshots, and category/brand24h auxiliary labels limit production and advertisement-attribution claims.
